verdict.rationale: The docs show you can submit long autonomous research jobs: Kosmos runs full research workflows unattended, and create_task returns a task id so you can submit many jobs and query the results later. However, the only completion mechanism evidenced is polling or blocking (run_tasks_until_done, 'wait for them to complete'), with no push notification to the user. Missing for 10: any notification mechanism (email, webhook or callback) when results are ready, documented job duration or durability limits, and independent hands-on corroboration.
